chunks: That the reason for that is that Allah, the Exalted, prescribed five obligatory prayers upon the people, so He made for the deceased one takbir from each obligatory prayer.
ai.seo_question: Why are there five takbirs in salat al-janazah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives the rationale for the five takbirs in the funeral prayer. It states that Allah has prescribed five obligatory daily prayers, and one takbir for the deceased corresponds to each of those obligations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: that the reason behind this practice is that Allah (swt), the Exalted, has prescribed five obligatory prayers for people, and thus, one takbir is designated for the deceased from each of these obligatory prayers.
